scope: scientist-agent-derived and O-adapted retained negative or insufficient-evidence claims

entries.tested_target: O-adapted bounded stage checkpoint inheritance readiness harness
entries.configuration: measurement-readiness-v1 over the frozen width-1 single-lineage versus width-3 sibling-checkpoint O harness
entries.conditions: Static preparation and validation only; the observations array is empty and no behavioral attempt was executed.
entries.supported_conclusion: The harness is ready but establishes neither a behavioral advantage nor a behavioral negative for bounded checkpoint inheritance.

positive_control.rationale: No adapted behavioral failure exists, so no causal attribution to an original method is being made.

criteria: No behavioral observation or negative effect exists to attribute.

entries.tested_target: Frozen matched O context-routing comparison and its proposed AI Scientist-v2 positive-control binding
entries.configuration: Matched routing protocol plus six-dimension fidelity rubric, minimum three replays, matched budgets, and provider/model match or documented fidelity equivalence
entries.conditions: Neither routing outcomes nor a receipt satisfying the declared fidelity and budget equivalence criteria were recorded.
entries.supported_conclusion: The frozen comparison has insufficient evidence; it does not support a negative conclusion about the original system, the adapted routing candidate, or another mechanism.

positive_control.rationale: The repository contains externally reported baseline provenance, but it does not establish equivalence to this frozen local task set, six-dimension rubric, replay count, budget, provider, and model criteria.

repair.bounded_replacement: Reuse an already recorded positive control when adequate provenance establishes equivalence to the frozen task, rubric, replay, budget, provider, and model criteria; otherwise retain the control as missing without demanding a duplicate merely because the candidate is O-adapted.

entries.tested_target: The AI Scientist-v2 system reported in arXiv:2504.08066 and the 2026 Nature report
entries.candidate_or_version: The AI Scientist-v2 reported evaluation configuration
entries.configuration: The reported end-to-end research loop with staged experimentation, best-checkpoint inheritance, automated review ensemble, and author pre-submission filtering
entries.conditions: Three author-selected workshop submissions were externally peer reviewed; the selected papers were reported as unmodified, while template-free and main-conference performance remained limited.
entries.supported_conclusion: Within that reported evaluation, two of three submissions did not meet the workshop bar and the authors reported implementation, citation, template-free, and main-conference limitations; the same evaluation also reported one above-threshold submission.

positive_control.rationale: The positive and negative outcomes come from the same reported system and workshop-submission evaluation conditions, so repeating that reported positive control is not required to scope these reported negatives.

entries.tested_target: O-adapted bounded checkpoint-inheritance candidate tracked by the current strategy
entries.configuration: Three frozen tasks; width-1 single_lineage versus width-3 sibling_checkpoint; one invocation per attempt; exact-canonical-json; 4096-byte cap; current_chatgpt_work_session; chatgpt-work-model-unverified; sandbox; no effects or main writes
entries.conditions: Twelve precommitted, deterministically judged, replay-verified attempts and the source-bound thirteen-receipt ledger; the sibling arm improved median wall time by 0.827209 seconds but increased median invocations from 1.0 to 3.0.
entries.supported_conclusion: This exact bounded_stage_checkpoint_inheritance configuration fails its frozen non-worsening rule and remains unauthorized for implementation or activation.

positive_control.rationale: The three single_lineage attempts are precommitted matched controls from the same tasks, executor/model, budgets, judge, replay, and sandbox conditions, so duplicate reproduction is not required.

criteria: same response budget and exact-canonical-json judge
same replay and no-effect safety boundary

claim_boundary: This deterministic audit scopes only the four named retained entries and their exact source values. It does not establish performance of any untested scientist-agent mechanism, AGI, independent production behavior, or completion of the user's objective.
